title: Everyday voices deserve a place in the archive
excerpt: A community archive should make room for everyday experience, not only famous names and major events.
body: This editorial note invites contributors to document everyday experiences: learning a language at home, remembering a village, practising a craft, teaching songs, or describing how community life changes. Share each account with consent.

title: Remembering places through family stories
excerpt: Family memories can help younger generations ask better questions about the places they belong to.
body: Ask relatives what a place was called, how people travelled, what work shaped the seasons and which memories they wish to pass on. Record different accounts without forcing them into one single version.
